tasks.short: Monitor material performance and evaluate deterioration

steps.what: Inspect actual material specimens or installed components and obtain the required performance/deterioration measurements
Enter and check actual performance readings, specimen identity, units and deterioration observations in the laboratory record
Save the checked material monitoring record in the laboratory system
Compare actual performance trends with material requirements and evaluate deterioration mechanisms and uncertainty
inputs: actual historical measurements and material requirements

tasks.design: Configure native instrument import and trend views in {OTHER}, the laboratory information and materials-analysis software. The engineer obtains the actual measurements, checks imported values alongside manually entered observations before saving, and evaluates deterioration from the actual evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transcription of exportable readings and repeated trend navigation can interrupt monitoring.
tasks.enabler_now: Native instrument import and saved trend views can reuse existing readings.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling validity and deterioration mechanisms require physical and engineering assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a material change from a measurement or sampling problem.

ambition.what: No automatic material release or failure prediction claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for laboratory records and instrument export access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native instrument imports and trend views can reduce handling while engineers retain measurement validity and deterioration assessment.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured instrument-supported monitoring scenario, not a measured baseline or the prompt prior.

The instrument produces actual value/unit/time exports; the engineer supplies specimen identity, method and observations in s1/s2. Non-exported readings and all visual observations remain manual within s2.
Import requires explicit specimen/method matching and stops on missing identity or unit mismatch. Existing equivalent imports/views remove the gain; no new sensor feed is assumed.
Gross provisional saving 5.8 minus 1 hour of mapping/view upkeep gives 4.8 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
The final monitoring entry is checked during ordinary entry work. No invented report or automatic alert is added.
unknowns: Existing instrument exports and time spent transcribing readings
research_questions: Which actual readings still require repeated manual entry after native laboratory tools are credited?

already_counted.description: Check imported/manual readings and interpret actual deterioration trends

incremental.description: Maintain instrument mappings and trend definitions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 4.8%; physical inspection and substantive deterioration assessment remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Replicate material and component characteristics using computers

steps.what: Define the material/component characteristics, constitutive assumptions and replication purpose from actual experimental evidence
inputs: actual material/component geometry and measured properties
replication question and intended validity domain
outputs: engineer's specified material representation and assumptions

steps.what: Set up the computer representation of material and component characteristics in native simulation software
inputs: engineer's specified material representation and assumptions
actual geometry and property values with units/provenance

steps.what: Run the computer model and inspect convergence, mesh sensitivity and replication of measured material behaviour
outputs: validated or rejected replication results with limitations

steps.what: Complete and check the actual model version, result annotations and validity limitations
inputs: validated or rejected replication results with limitations

steps.what: Save the completed checked material replication model/version

tasks.design: Configure native reusable material cards and model profiles in {OTHER}, the materials simulation application, for the engineer's selected representation. The engineer verifies property units, inspects numerical and physical validity, and completes the actual model annotations before saving; existing solver execution earns no new saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated native material-card and model setup can consume human effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable configurations can carry actual property definitions into another suitable model.
tasks.still_hard: A numerically executable representation may not reproduce the actual material.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a defensible constitutive representation and reject a misleading fit.

ambition.what: No automatic materials qualification or design release.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reusable material cards can reduce repeated setup while physical validation and model suitability remain engineering work.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human effort and exclude unattended solver runtime; no observed baseline is claimed.
Test engineers supply actual property/validation measurements with method, specimen and units; the materials engineer selects relevant values and enters missing definitions within s1/s2.
Only repeated configuration changes. New material characterization, geometry repair and novel constitutive work remain retained; existing equivalent profiles remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 4.5 minus 1.5 hours of profile validation/upkeep gives 3 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: How often material cards can actually be reused
research_questions: Does reuse reduce human setup after required unit, constitutive and validity checks?

already_counted.description: Inspect configured model and validate actual behaviour

incremental.description: Validate and maintain reusable material profiles

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3%; numerical runtime already belongs to today's computer-assisted work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train customers and employees on materials, applications and manufacturing methods

steps.what: Select and adapt actual current material-product, application or manufacturing-method instruction for the customer session
inputs: actual current technical instructions and product/process limits

steps.what: Conduct training sessions explaining and demonstrating the actual new material products, applications or manufacturing methods
inputs: actual customer personnel and demonstration equipment/materials

steps.what: Answer actual application questions, observe practice where appropriate and correct unsafe or mistaken interpretations
outputs: actual clarified instruction and observed learning limits

tasks.design: Configure native links to current product/application/method instructions in {DOCS} for actual session preparation. The engineer adapts the technical explanation, conducts the session and handles questions/practice; no extra attendance report or customer message is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Session preparation can involve repeated retrieval of current technical instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version links can shorten retrieval without generating technical claims.
tasks.still_hard: Correct application depends on customer context and demonstrated understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a dangerous interpretation and teach the relevant limit.

ambition.what: No extra training capacity or automatic competence claim.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native instruction links can reduce retrieval while technical teaching and practice feedback remain human work.

assumptions: Shares are an unmeasured session including real technical adaptation, not administration invented after each conversation.
Product/process owners maintain the actual instructions; customers state needs; the engineer checks suitability in s1. Missing current instructions are resolved manually.
Only source navigation changes. Existing equivalent links remove the gain. No send, record commitment or competence certification is part of this session scenario.
Gross provisional saving 1 minus 0.5 hour of instruction-link upkeep gives 0.5 net.
research_questions: Is retrieving current instructions a real recurring burden in customer sessions?

already_counted.description: Check and adapt actual session instruction

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 0.5%; delivery and application feedback remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach materials engineering in colleges and universities

steps.what: Prepare the actual materials-engineering lesson from course objectives, current examples and existing teaching resources
inputs: actual course objectives and existing teaching resources
actual lesson topic and student needs

steps.what: Teach the actual college/university class, explain material behaviour and respond to student questions
outputs: actual class instruction and student explanations

steps.what: Evaluate actual student materials-engineering work and compose checked feedback and marks
outputs: complete checked feedback and marks for actual students

steps.what: Release the completed checked feedback and marks to the intended students in the existing learning system
inputs: complete checked feedback and marks for actual students

tasks.design: Configure native topic/resource links in {LMS} and {DOCS} for actual lesson preparation. The engineer teaches and assesses actual work, completing and checking student-specific feedback/marks before the separate release; no automatic grading or new reporting task is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation can involve repeated navigation to existing course resources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native course/topic links can expose existing materials directly.
tasks.still_hard: Student understanding and engineering reasoning require contextual assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why a plausible material-selection argument fails.

ambition.what: No automatic grading or expanded class size claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for course resource and assessment permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course-resource links can reduce navigation while teaching and student assessment remain human work.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured teaching cycle with actual assessment; they are not measured lesson times.
The teacher maintains resources/objectives and assessment criteria; students produce actual submissions. All new explanation and feedback writing remains counted.
Only resource retrieval changes; existing equivalent links remove the gain. Student-specific marks remain in the institution's existing system.
Gross provisional saving 1 minus 0.5 hour of resource-link upkeep gives 0.5 net. Release is negligible and fully retained.
Final content/student identity is checked in normal assessment authoring; any edit invalidates the release gate. Do not add this broad teaching cycle to separate overlapping teaching tasks.
unknowns: Existing course navigation and overlap with other teaching tasks
research_questions: Does actual lesson preparation repeat resource navigation beyond native LMS tools?

already_counted.description: Prepare actual lesson and assess student work

approvals.approved_version: complete checked feedback and marks for actual students

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 0.5%; actual teaching, assessment and release remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
